AI_API_KEY.description: Optional. An OpenAI-compatible API key (DeepSeek by default) turns on AI readings. Empty = charts only.

AI_BASE_URL.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL. OpenAI: https://api.openai.com/v1, OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1

AI_MODEL.description: Model name at that API, e.g. gpt-5-mini on OpenAI or deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash on OpenRouter

AI_REQUESTS_PER_HOUR.description: AI requests allowed per visitor IP per hour, so a public site can't drain your key. 0 = no limit

PORT.description: Port the site listens on. Leave as is.
